Serious fouls per eligible incident, stratified by Discipline; retain numerator and denominator.
Home versus neutral comparison; crowd effect vanishes after five losses; confidence disabled in isolated test.
Evaluate at the score-triggered halftime break; deficit, observed performance, personnel, fatigue and distance from original root strategy.
Fixed weather scenarios before live retrieval; inspect action-specific effects and fatigue.

Shared-player exposure and diminishing coordination returns.

Limited local influence based on existing attributes.
Short-lived effect, decay at intervals, runaway-match frequency.

Effort, tactical risk, fatigue and discipline tradeoffs.

Decision changes without duplicating pressure or halftime effects.

baseline-equivalence.goal: Exact v1.0/v2.0 sporting equivalence, excluding only the top-level and match_start engineVersion labels.

single-feature.goal: One implemented feature at a time; match seeds, opponents and simulation sides.

interactions.goal: Inspect stacking and double counting after individual features pass.

season-rehearsal.goal: Fresh validation seeds and accumulating histories; no official writes.

streak-pilot.goal: Separate and combined confidence/frustration arms; pinned coefficients, exposures, paired outcomes and uncertainty.
